notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hi,

I'm pleased to announce after a short round of private testing and feedback the Demo is ready to go live.

This is still a work in progress so I'll explain what the Demo 0.1.6.0 will release with and what I intend to work on while its released until I shift gears to working on the final game.

[b]The Demo will release with access to:[/b]
[list]
[*]2 Characters, The Tanky Minnie (Shire - Green Tank) and The Speedy Sadie (Quarter - Red Tank)
[*]16 Items
[*]1 Stage (The Factory)
[*]12 Pickups
[*]3 Bosses (Weather Machine, Hell Rider, Prototype Core)
[/list]

[b]What I intend to work on over the course of the Demo:[/b]
[list]
[*]Responding to feedback, I'm listening and making changes right now in private feedback sessions, hearing a new players perspective is very helpful, I intend to do the same when the Demo is public
[*]New variations on the Static Defenses (the little activatable pop-up turrets), this is a mechanic I feel is underused right now with only a rapidfire gun version, I intend to beef them up with missile, flame and utility variants
[*]Elemental Effects, you can deal elemental damage right now, as a means of counteracting armour and shield, but I like the idea of more interactive effects such as fire explosions, corrosive pools, nanite swarms, and shock chains, so its high up on my todo list.
[*]More kinds of Debris (barrels), they bounce around nicely now, but I'd love them to also explode, or smash, or behave in some way that makes them a more varied experience.
[*]Add more pickups, napalm, companion spawn, temporary turret swap, elemental effect boost, I have a dozen ideas and I want them in.
[*]Info Database, while this exists for skill cards, I want to make one for enemies, pickups and damage types too.
[/list]

[b]Currently Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sadie is missing her loading screen animation, allow Minnie to dance for her a little while longer as I finish her animation!
[*]Pickups will sometimes not pull towards you if they sit near specific map boundaries (still pickup-able with contact)
[/list]

Cheers,
Scott
Nos Games
